title: Airtel Rs 3,999 annual prepaid plan gets 150GB extra data: Check benefits and validity- Moneycontrol.com
text:
My Alerts Go Ad-Free Follow us on: Airtel has added an extra 150GB of bulk data to its Rs 3,999 annual prepaid recharge plan as part of a limited-time offer. The plan also includes daily data, unlimited 5G, calls, SMS and additional digital benefits.   September 15, 2026 / 17:29 IST             Airtel has added more data benefits to the Rs 3,999 yearly prepaid plan. The added benefit comes in the form of additional 150GB of bulk data. The bonus data is available on top of the plan's regular daily data allowance and remains valid for the full 365-day validity period. Airtel describes the 150GB addition as a limited-time offer, so customers considering the annual recharge may want to check whether the benefit is still available when they recharge. The plan provides 2.5GB of high-speed data every day, which translates to a substantial data allowance over the year. Once the daily quota is exhausted, speeds are reduced to up to 64 Kbps. Unlimited 5G is included The Rs 3,999 recharge also comes with unlimited 5G data for eligible Airtel customers when they are connected to an Airtel 5G network. This benefit is provided over and above the plan's regular data allowance. However, Airtel's commercial usage policy applies. Data consumption exceeding 300GB within 30 days is considered commercial usage. For calling, subscribers get unlimited local and STD voice calls, along with 100 SMS per day. After the daily SMS allowance is used, additional local messages cost Re 1 each, while STD SMS are charged at Rs 1.5 each. More benefits included with the annual recharge The plan also bundles several additional services. Subscribers get 12 months of Adobe Express Premium, which Airtel values at around Rs 4,000. Airtel is also providing Airtel Safe, which includes features such as spam call alerts, blocking of fraudulent links and protection against OTP-based banking fraud. Users additionally get free HelloTunes, allowing them to set a caller tune at no extra cost, with the option to change it once every 30 days. Plan summary 2.5GB daily data with 365 days of validity. 150GB bonus data as a limited-time promotional benefit. Unlimited 5G data for eligible Airtel customers on the Airtel 5G network. Unlimited calls and 100 SMS per day across local and STD numbers. 12 months of Adobe Express Premium, along with Airtel Safe and free HelloTunes. What does the Airtel plan cost per day? With a validity of 365 days, the Rs 3,999 recharge works out to approximately Rs 10.96 per day. For users who want to avoid monthly recharges and consume significant amounts of mobile data, the combination of 2.5GB daily data, 150GB bonus data and unlimited 5G makes the annual plan a more comprehensive option. The extra 150GB, however, is a limited-period promotional benefit and is therefore subject to availability when the recharge is made. Airtel has added an extra 150GB of bulk data to its Rs 3,999 annual prepaid recharge plan as part of a limited-time offer. The plan also includes daily data, unlimited 5G, calls, SMS and additional digital benefits.

September 15, 2026 / 17:29 IST

Airtel has added more data benefits to the Rs 3,999 yearly prepaid plan. The added benefit comes in the form of additional 150GB of bulk data. The bonus data is available on top of the plan's regular daily data allowance and remains valid for the full 365-day validity period.

Airtel describes the 150GB addition as a limited-time offer, so customers considering the annual recharge may want to check whether the benefit is still available when they recharge.

The plan provides 2.5GB of high-speed data every day, which translates to a substantial data allowance over the year. Once the daily quota is exhausted, speeds are reduced to up to 64 Kbps.

Unlimited 5G is included

The Rs 3,999 recharge also comes with unlimited 5G data for eligible Airtel customers when they are connected to an Airtel 5G network. This benefit is provided over and above the plan's regular data allowance.

However, Airtel's commercial usage policy applies. Data consumption exceeding 300GB within 30 days is considered commercial usage.

For calling, subscribers get unlimited local and STD voice calls, along with 100 SMS per day. After the daily SMS allowance is used, additional local messages cost Re 1 each, while STD SMS are charged at Rs 1.5 each.

More benefits included with the annual recharge

The plan also bundles several additional services. Subscribers get 12 months of Adobe Express Premium, which Airtel values at around Rs 4,000.

Airtel is also providing Airtel Safe, which includes features such as spam call alerts, blocking of fraudulent links and protection against OTP-based banking fraud.

Users additionally get free HelloTunes, allowing them to set a caller tune at no extra cost, with the option to change it once every 30 days.

Plan summary

2.5GB daily data with 365 days of validity.150GB bonus data as a limited-time promotional benefit.Unlimited 5G data for eligible Airtel customers on the Airtel 5G network.Unlimited calls and 100 SMS per day across local and STD numbers.12 months of Adobe Express Premium, along with Airtel Safe and free HelloTunes.

What does the Airtel plan cost per day?

With a validity of 365 days, the Rs 3,999 recharge works out to approximately Rs 10.96 per day.

For users who want to avoid monthly recharges and consume significant amounts of mobile data, the combination of 2.5GB daily data, 150GB bonus data and unlimited 5G makes the annual plan a more comprehensive option.

The extra 150GB, however, is a limited-period promotional benefit and is therefore subject to availability when the recharge is made.
